lines.en: I tap on Kirin's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Hihi~
: How's it going, [kirinmaster]?
: Hey. Are you free right now?
: Mmm...depends. How much do you miss me?
: The...normal amount?
: You're gonna have to give me a little more than that if you want to see me right now.
: I'm on my way to meet up with people.
: Fine. I miss you more than the normal amount.
: ...You're really bad at this.
: But yeah, I can be free I guess.
: Is this an invite to your place?
: It is. I'm heading there now.
: Kay~ Need me to bring anything?
: Yeah, ask your sister if she wants to-
: Hanging up now~
: Why, hello there~
: What can I do for you today, [kirinmaster]?
How should I spend my time with Kirin?
